text_block_list.text:
The day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. The 
audience's attention was fixed on—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! When it comes to sheer presence, 
wouldn't she even give Senior Class girls 
a run for their money?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Look at her track record! She's been 
winning steadily all the way here. She's 
definitely going to be the queen of the 
new generation!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Load me up with whatever 
expectations you've got!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Leave all of it to big sis Hishi Ama!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama-san really is so cool.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So confident, so full of energy... Hishi 
Ama-san really is a 'city girl' too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Right, I've seen plenty of "City Girls" 
before.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's got their own identity and 
acts dignified. But they've got their own 
worries too... They ain't world's apart 
from me after all.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All that time you spent worrying and 
trying your hardest... that's what's gonna 
make you shine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Then, I can become one too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll even beat Hishi Ama-san and shine 
brighter than any other girl here today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show everyone the "City Girl" 
I've always dreamed of!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...I can't quite take my eyes off Yukino 
Bijin today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
It got so overhyped last year that I was 
starting to get a little sick of it, 
but... Maybe I'll sit down and properly 
watch it today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: How the "Snow Angel" is running right now—
